A further slowdown averaging four percentage points per quarter would leave June above -5% and take September below it.

One-Way Truckload and Logistics already faced both less freight than seasonally normal and increased price competition (D). At that volume decline, a yield gain near 2% would put revenue down at least 5%. I forecast yield gains above that level in June and near or below it in September.

Meanwhile, fuel surcharge revenue rose $4.9 million year over year, cushioning the reported total (A, D, E). I forecast that cushion helps keep June above -5%, then a smaller surcharge benefit and continued rate pressure take reported September revenue to a decline of at least 5%.
